_comment: Per-role model map for the Deep Research Tool. Edit a value to override the default, then restart the server (in-app 'Restart Server' or POST /api/restart) to apply. Roles: extract = per-page extraction + classify; search = the lane navigators (Stage 2 lanes, Stages 3/4, gap rounds); route = relevance filters, stop-judge, gap-queries, titles, baseline query-gen, the Odysseus pre-pass; plan = the planner, lane planning, and the lead review; dig = the hot-trail digger; synthesize = the cited report (the deliverable). 2026-09-03 split (orchestrator-worker pattern): navigators + extraction/routing on Sonnet 5, judgment + deliverable on Opus 4.8. Effort is set in engines/research/llm.py (env DRT_EFFORT).
